notes: **What I changed:** The dedup is global across the whole string, not per-segment. The first word's letters are consumed first; the rest-block then dedups against those already-seen letters before reversing. This single rule now explains every multi-word case in E1–E9 (previously the model deduped the rest-block in isolation, which broke on "one two three", "sun moon star", "big red dog", etc.).
